title: OP1 resolved — Android wrapper technology for the existing Flask/SQLite core
decision: PATH-B (Chaquopy). Chaquopy is the primary wrapper for the Android port; PATH-A (python-for-android webview bootstrap) is kept as a proven fallback.
decision_line: D6-style: OP1 = PATH-B Chaquopy — chosen because it builds the working APK in 56 s with no NDK, no host autotools and no source compilation of CPython (Gradle + pip only), versus PATH-A's ~15 min cold build that needed an NDK plus three host-specific recipe overrides; both paths install and render the unmodified Flask UI on device.

acceptance.A1_both_evaluated: PASS — both paths produced an installable APK with logged build results
acceptance.A2_device_proof: PASS — BOTH APKs install on Waydroid and load the Flask/Jinja UI (screenshots)
acceptance.A3_decision_recorded: PASS — this document + comment on issue #109

comparison.path_a: high but depends on recipe overrides + NDK major-version pin
comparison.path_b: high — prebuilt runtime + pip + Gradle dependencies are declarative

why_path_b: Much cheaper and more reliable build: 56 s vs ~15 min, and no NDK and no host autotools, so no host-specific recipe surgery (PATH-A needed 3 workarounds rooted in this machine's missing autotools and p4a internals).
Gradle-native: integrates with standard Android tooling, CI, release signing and future Play packaging instead of a bespoke p4a/buildozer pipeline.
Deterministic: a prebuilt CPython runtime and prebuilt Android wheels replace compiling CPython, OpenSSL and SQLite from source at build time.
Both paths already proved the deliverable is achievable; the tie-breakers are build cost, build integration and reproducibility, all of which favour Chaquopy.
Licence is clear: Chaquopy is MIT.
tradeoffs_accepted: APK is larger: 22.7 MB vs 13.1 MB (+~75%). Acceptable for a personal offline app.
Python is 3.11 vs 3.14. Both satisfy requires-python >=3.10. Stage 2 should pin Chaquopy to Python 3.13 to satisfy the 16KB-page-size advice recorded in the foundation report (Android 15+ / Play).
Adds one third-party Gradle plugin dependency (MIT).
fallback: PATH-A (p4a webview) is proven working (smaller APK, newer Python) and stays available if Chaquopy hits a blocker later (e.g. a missing native wheel or a subprocess limitation for the on-device pytest story in Stage 4).
stage2_recommendations: Use Chaquopy; pin app Python to 3.13 (16KB page-size readiness) and abiFilters to arm64-v8a (+ x86_64 for local Waydroid smoke).
Keep the WebView + 127.0.0.1 Flask pattern proven here; add the network-security-config for localhost per AND-03/M1.
Reuse android/spike/path_b/ as the skeleton seed for the Stage 2 android/ project.
